scenario.topic: Choose a ticket pricing model for a local esports tournament

options.name: Flat Rate Admission
options.upside: Simple and easy to understand for attendees.
options.concern: Does not differentiate between casual and dedicated fans.

options.name: Tiered Pricing by Seating Area
options.upside: Offers options for different budgets and preferences.
options.concern: Requires more complex ticket management and seating assignments.

options.name: Early Bird and Regular Pricing
options.upside: Encourages early sales and better attendance forecasting.
options.concern: May cause confusion about pricing deadlines.

options.name: Day Pass and Full Event Pass

attrs.access_level: day pass limits to one day, full pass all days

options.upside: Provides flexibility for attendees with limited availability.
options.concern: Could reduce overall revenue if many choose day passes.

shared_context: A local esports tournament needs to select a ticket pricing model. The event expects a mix of casual attendees and competitive fans, with a venue capacity of 500 and a target revenue of $10,000.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is an event coordinator who values attendee flexibility and maximizing participation.
personas.private_goal: Ensure the pricing model encourages attendance from people who can only come for part of the event.

A.reason_for: Simple pricing is easy for attendees to understand.
A.reason_against: Does not offer flexibility for those who want to attend only one day.

B.reason_for: Provides options for different budgets and preferences.
B.reason_against: Complex seating management might complicate the event logistics.

C.reason_for: Encourages early sales which helps with planning attendance.
C.reason_against: Pricing deadlines may confuse some attendees.

D.reason_for: Offers flexibility with day passes for those with limited availability.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a competitive gamer focused on simplicity and fairness in ticket pricing.
personas.private_goal: Choose a straightforward pricing model that treats all attendees equally.

A.reason_for: Flat rate is simple and easy to understand for everyone.

B.reason_for: Offers budget options but adds complexity.
B.reason_against: More complex ticket management and seating assignments are a downside.

C.reason_for: Early bird pricing encourages early commitment.

D.reason_for: Flexibility is good but may reduce overall revenue.
D.reason_against: Could lead to many choosing cheaper day passes, lowering total income.

personas.name: Zoe
personas.background: Zoe is a local esports fan and community organizer who values choice and inclusivity.
personas.private_goal: Select a pricing model that accommodates different fan engagement levels and budgets.

A.reason_against: Fails to differentiate between casual and dedicated fans, limiting options.

B.reason_for: Offers tiered pricing that matches different budgets and preferences.

C.reason_for: Early bird pricing helps with forecasting attendance.
C.reason_against: Pricing deadlines may confuse some attendees.

D.reason_for: Provides flexibility for attendees with limited availability.
D.reason_against: Could reduce overall revenue if many choose day passes.
